source_checks.result: Pinned GA dc2e74c config, Phase 0 report, Phase 2 validation and dated plan agree. The lesson separates proxy from full harness, single-embed from chat latency, and routing config from persisted-store migration.
source_checks.arithmetic: Latency margin 261.72520000545774 ms; bge versus nomic p95 difference 136.8259000009857 ms; accuracy gain 1.2 percentage points; OOS 3/8 to 8/8 gain 62.5 points. The plan separately records 7/8 on a later local run.

source_checks.result: Demerzel 74d425d triage generator explicitly grants no approval. Pinned 7892390 evaluator/result require matching source identities and checks; current and portable each admit 3/3 with synthetic medians 40 and 32. Fast admits 1/3. These are imaginary adapters and fictional verdict/check labels.
source_checks.historical_fix: The mutable PR #170 reference is now an immutable Learn 02fc08c experiment link, with closed-unmerged status, current helper absence, Learn source ownership and no approval made explicit. The declared edit reconstructs.

source_checks.result: IX bd1336b serializes lowercase holds/fails/unknown while its Rust enum variants are Holds/Fails/Unknown. Deadlock discovery yields Fails even if exploration truncates, and a witness limit may be zero. normalize rejects empty, negative, NaN and zero-sum inputs; the lesson adds finite-count validation because positive infinity is not explicitly rejected.
source_checks.boundary: A synthetic histogram shift does not establish regression, causality, statistical significance, a deployed threshold or a scheduled DuckDB comparison.

source_checks.result: GA dc2e74c progression YAML and ProgressionCorpusItem declarations agree with the quoted fields and counts. ii-V-I, 12-Bar Blues, Rhythm Changes and nested/standalone Pop Loop entries are distinguished correctly. The blues positions 5,6,9,12 are A,A,B,B.
source_checks.cultural_boundary: Catalog genre, AAB, song and UsedBy text are editorial claims, not verified performance history. Required Source/StyleLabel strings do not authenticate attribution. The proposed 10/12 matching rule is not a validated genre criterion.

source_checks.result: Demerzel 9ba9a29 advisory prose, schema and AIW rule-pack document have the stated vocabulary drift: recommend_merge/numeric confidence/reasons versus recommend/categorical confidence/reason_codes. The schema permits empty evidence arrays. Its compatible shape cannot establish evidence relevance or merge authority.
source_checks.boundary: The quoted policy keeps advice dry-run and human authority separate. No live service or actual PR decision is established.

source_checks.result: Pinned GA schema/theory/ICV sources and Demerzel 50c0d2f fixture support the distinct equivalence relations. C major and C minor share ICV [0,0,1,1,1,0] and supplied root 0 but differ in chroma; (-pc+7) mod 12 maps one set to the other. C diminished has ICV [0,0,2,0,0,1].
source_checks.boundary: Toy binary-chroma cosines are not full STRUCTURE scores. Whole STRUCTURE is not transposition invariant. A 0.75 threshold on scores 0.8/0.8/0.5 fails transitivity. No current retrieval or fingering result is inferred.

source_checks.result: The native 44.1 kHz fixture is distinguished from browser context/worklet rate. Static Nyquist arithmetic yields E2 harmonic limits 267 and 291 at 44.1/48 kHz. Ideal 30 kHz folds to 14.1/18 kHz; ideal 23 kHz folds to 21.1 kHz in the stated unfiltered 44.1 kHz model.
source_checks.boundary: The lesson does not claim an observed GA alias, browser capture, listening result or causal diagnosis. Root owns executable/source calculation receipts; this review did not duplicate executions.

source_checks.result: Pinned Rust excite/engine_note_on source maps velocity into pick ratio/offset, excitation, pluck mix and attack. With velocity 0.5 and length 535, ratio=0.48 and rounded offset=257. The ideal quarter-string harmonic zeros remain separate from the engine's broad filtered-noise heuristic.
source_checks.boundary: No physical-coordinate calibration, rendered spectrum, audible brightness result or public API change follows. Root owns physics fixture executions.

source_checks.result: The archived release evaluator checks exactly three targets with four boolean gates each, plus replay/hash gates. A runtime Godot candidate with failed meaning is rejected; other gaps hold for evidence; all modeled gates yield candidacy only. published_tag remains separate.
source_checks.boundary: Source scripts, checked sample reports, plans and synthetic weave counters do not establish an installable extension suite, real human approval or public release.

source_checks.result: Pinned GA F# parser, renderer, service, tests and projectChord closure agree: Cmi7→Cm7, D-7→Dm7, EbΔ9→Ebmaj9; Fmaj7/A has Quality=None and an Extension maj7; C13#11b9 has three components. C# and Db spell differently while projecting to pitch class 1.
source_checks.boundary: Canonical spelling loses original glyph choice. Source/test declarations do not establish a fresh test pass, executed closure, voiced performance or UI result.

source_checks.result: At Demerzel c453a91, SEM-002 remains in_progress with review/publish false, while its separate bounded AI receipt reports no findings. The reporter requires review.completed AND verdict approved. The preflight has an explicit in_progress flag rule but does not fetch the public site.
source_checks.boundary: Schema compatibility, AI scope, local generation and historical DV-001 public 404 remain separate evidence claims. None grants human review or publication of SEM-002/003.

source_checks.result: Pinned VoicingCloud/ForceRadiant source supports nine floats for three points, default spread 1.5, default size 0.3, resampling on positive setSpread and unchanged centers under setPointSize. Selected draws produce x=-1.2/1.4 and a 2.6 gap versus 0.2 base gap. A total-three payload with only two copied blocks leaves one zero-filled destination point.
source_checks.boundary: The lesson does not equate jittered display coordinates with full musical similarity or claim a real IX payload, browser frame, seeded layout or usability outcome.

source_checks.result: Learn 93d424f modeling/material scripts and checked reports contain the cited open-quad/non-manifold examples and per-corner UV/glTF observations on other assets. GA's host/unchecked plan items do not establish a folded scene. Signed errors 2° and 121° are correct; lower comprehension and an incorrect ID reject the synthetic candidate.
source_checks.cultural_boundary: Fold signs, policy meanings and tolerances are declared trial conventions, not historical origami claims, cultural analysis, physically valid motion or an implemented semantic format.

archived_translation_review.scope: Full semantic comparison of the four archived bodies and all five exercises/answers per lesson against English. This is not human fluency approval.
archived_translation_review.result: No substantive omission, altered answer, mistaken wire-label instruction or upgraded authority claim found.
archived_translation_review.inf003: Both locales preserve serialized lowercase tags, actual capitalized Rust variants, fixed-property/order requirements, normalization and finite-count caveats, KL argument direction/error, JS midpoint/values/nats-to-bits conversion, witness/exploration controls, hypothetical threshold and all five exercises. First-paragraph Fails is an actual enum variant, not a claim that the serialized field value is capitalized.
archived_translation_review.sem003: Both locales preserve the communication-word/status-enum distinction, scoped AI review, false review/publish flags, completed AND approved predicate, schema versus preflight gap, dated DV-001 local/public distinction, source-bound handoff chain and all five exercises. Shorter paraphrases do not remove the relevant field predicates or pending human/learner limits.
archived_translation_review.canonical_href: Both physical SEM-003 translations now use sem-001-signs-in-governance.md.
archived_translation_review.token_difference_boundary: Combined formulas or repeated-field paraphrases explain token-count differences. Semantic agreement is not a claim of byte-for-byte token parity.

Les mentions historiques de traductions encore à rédiger, d’une absence d’importation ou de compilation dans Learn concernent cette étape antérieure ; ce [dossier de transfert](../../../../code/streeling/evidence/representation-release-2026-10-22/README.md) décrit les brouillons de traduction actuels, l’importation et ses vérifications. notes.es: > **Alcance de la fuente y la transferencia.** El texto técnico siguiente procede de un borrador archivado. Las menciones históricas de traducciones todavía no redactadas, de una importación o compilación pendiente en Learn corresponden a aquella etapa; este [registro de transferencia](../../../../code/streeling/evidence/representation-release-2026-10-22/README.md) documenta los borradores traducidos actuales, la importación y sus comprobaciones.
